title: Mixed Event — One Small Trip Before a Big Journey — Episode6 Led Onto The Water

meta.Event: One Small Trip Before a Big Journey
meta.Event Outline: The Miya Girls first years are headed to Yokohama! Haruka realizes this field trip might be her last memory with her general education class before returning to the credit-based course. Saki asks to be in her group for the trip.

rows.Line: Outside the Red Brick Center

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
That was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It was interesting to see so many different kinds of shops.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! I couldn't help but get carried away looking around the shop with all sorts of stuff from Scandinavia. Having some of that in my room would totally brighten my mood any day!

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line:
I've always liked those kinds of things too!
Also, can we talk about how nice those fragrance shops were?

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: Actually, yes. Not only were the scents really nice, but the way they displayed all of the perfumes was so pretty too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You can say that again!
All of the shops were pretty busy, huh? I thought it'd be quieter since it's a weekday, but I guess I was wrong!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Speaking of which, is it just me or has it gotten even busier?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, so you think so too? I was just thinking that a bit earlier...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I guess it is also after lunchtime, but I wonder... Could they be looking for Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That is a possibility. The people that passed by us before did say that they saw posts about her on social media.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Here, look. This video has the title, “Haruka Kiritani being sweet to elementary school kids!”
It's trending and there's four thousand likes on it already.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! F-Four thousand?! That's amazing! Good work, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: Now's not the time to be celebrating!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: “Red Brick Center” is written in the description, so I'm sure that's why people came looking.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It seems like leaving early was the right decision...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe, now that we're heading off somewhere else, I'm sure we won't have to worry about anyone finding us!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well then, let's head over to—

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wah...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa! What was that?!
That strong wind just came out of nowhere... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ah! My hat!

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line: Huh? That girl over there, is that...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Oh no...
Even if it was just for a second, our eyes met...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wh-What should we do?! At this rate...

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: Kiritani's going to be found out and there's nowhere to hide!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, what if we hide her with our bodies?!
But that would look super unnatural!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Whoa! Hoshino?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kiritani! This way!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let's get on that! I think we'll make it just in time!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That? Do you mean the water taxi?

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: Hoshino?!

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: Sh-She just suddenly grabbed Kiritani's hand and took off...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Ichi.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But, that's a relief. I'm sure Haruka will be fine.

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, now it's my turn...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ah! Look over there!
There's Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line: What? Where?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Looks like she went to that park over there!

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line: Really? Shall we go have a look?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh! Another big success!

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: Nice work, Saki! You're a genius!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe, you flatter me as you should!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (To be honest... I feel kind of bad for doing something like this to Haruka's fans.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But this is our one field trip together. If this is what needs to be done for Haruka to enjoy herself, then...)

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line:
So what should we do now?
Should we follow them?

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: I think they got on the water taxi, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup!
Let's go ahead and wait for them at their arrival terminal!
Water Taxi

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sorry for suddenly dragging you like that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It's okay, I'm glad you did.
Looks like there aren't many people here, so we should be able to relax.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There were quite a lot of people looking over there, and if they'd found me, I don't know if we'd have been able to carry on with our field trip.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: More importantly, I'm sorry for all of this. Because of me, we both got separated from the others.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, it's okay. Also, Saki sent a message just before.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Here, in the group chat. “We'll be waiting at the arrival terminal!”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. I completely missed that...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It might not seem that way, but Saki has a good head on her shoulders, so I think we have nothing to worry about.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm sure they'll be having fun in their own way.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, right on cue.
They just sent a message and a photo.

rows.Speaker: Saki's Message
rows.Line: <We're on the way to the arrival terminal now! We'll be enjoying ourselves, so make sure you two have fun too♪>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They're all feeding each other.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They sure are. Looks like they're having fun.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You said that we got separated, but I think it's fine since it'll only be for a little while.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's not like we'll never see each other again. Once we meet up, let's make the most of the rest of the day and enjoy ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hoshino...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, you're right. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hm? Ah!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki and the others are eating crepes! I'm jealous, they look so good.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. You can tell from the look on their faces too. It's like they're saying, “Yum!”

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's a little unfair.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, shall we give them a taste of their own medicine?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Their own medicine?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. It's not food, but... We have a beautiful view of the water. Why don't we send a photo?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sounds good. Let's do that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, what pose should we do?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh, a pose? Do you mean like peace signs?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well, yes, but I was thinking that maybe we can do something a little cuter.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A cuter pose?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. For example, we can make hearts with our fingers and place them next to our cheeks.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I see... Then, how about a pose of us eating sweets? Saki and the others got to eat crepes, so we should try to rival that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Sweets? That's a good idea.
But would that come across without having any actual sweets?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: About that... The thing is, I actually have some donuts.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Here. I got them at the souvenir shop and thought that they might be a nice snack for all of us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wow, they look so yummy. But, are you okay with that?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well, I'd say it's perfect payback for the crepes.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe, right.
Okay, lean in.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hoshino, maybe try nibbling it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: L-Like this?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ooh, that's cute. Okay, here we go.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: H-How does it look?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It looks great. Alright, I'll send this over.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, okay. Thank you. It's a little embarrassing, but I wonder how they're going to react.

rows.Speaker: Saki's Message
rows.Line: <You're eating our snacks?! I thought you said they were for all of us?!?!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe, she sent an angry stamp.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Operation Payback was a success, then.
